title: AI Chat & UX Enhancements
description: A major overhaul of the Chat interface for improved usability, cleaner data presentation, and smarter AI interactions.

items.title: Chat Interface Experience
items.description: A refined and modern chat experience focusing on clarity and ease of use.
details: Compact, single-line input box that auto-expands as you type
Dynamic "Retry" button to quickly reload previous messages into the input
User profile pictures are now displayed in chat bubbles
New "Pegasus" AI avatar that adapts to Light/Dark mode
Added "Copy" button to all chat messages for quick access

items.title: Analytics & Logs
items.description: New dedicated settings tab for system monitoring (Desktop only).
details: View system analytics and operation logs directly in Settings
Automatically hides settings access on mobile devices for better UX

items.title: Data Exploration & Workflow
items.description: Enhanced tools for interacting with your data directly from the sidebar and results.
details: Added right-click Context Menu to Explorer tables (Preview, Edit, Rename, Delete)
New inline "Preview" (Eye) and "Edit" (Pencil) quick actions in the sidebar
"Open in Spreadsheet" button added to Results Panel for instant analysis
Ability to rename tables directly from the Explorer

items.title: Pro Subscription System
items.description: Complete payment and subscription management integration.
details: Stripe integration with support for coupons and promotion codes
Automatic subscription syncing on profile load
Manual 'Sync' capability for immediate status updates
Pro users get 900k AI tokens/month (vs 100k free)
Visual 'PRO' badge and ring indicator for subscribers

items.title: Performance Engineering
items.description: McMaster-Carr inspired optimizations for instant interactions.
details: Link Prefetching: Route chunks load on hover for instant navigation
Font Preloading & DNS Prefetching for faster LCP
Optimized vendor chunk splitting for aggressive caching
Enhanced build configuration for smaller bundle sizes

items.title: System Reliability
details: New dedicated Error Page with actionable steps
Standardized error codes across the application
Fixed cross-origin authentication for reliable production deployments
Improved webhook logging for better observability

items.title: Redefined UI Experience
items.description: A tighter, higher-density UI designed for data professionals.
details: Reduced chat input height and padding for maximum screen real estate
Compacted Results Panel toolbar and spacing
Refined button styles for a sleeker, more professional look

items.title: AI Sanitization Engine
items.description: Smart interception of raw data outputs to keep the chat clean.
details: Prevents raw JSON data dumps from cluttering the conversation
Automatically replaces technical outputs with friendly status messages
Directs users to the Results Panel for detailed data viewing

items.title: In-Stream Intelligence
items.description: Better integration of AI reasoning into the conversation flow.
details: Moved AI analysis and insights directly into the main chat history
Removed the redundant "Synthesized Insights" side panel
Renamed AI label to "PEGASUS" for consistent branding

items.title: Reduced Cognitive Load
items.description: Optimized when and how information is presented.
details: Disabled automatic post-analysis for manual query re-runs to reduce noise
Chat input automatically clears immediately after sending a message
Visual cleanups to remove distracting artifacts
